source_title: Unraveling MECP2 structural variants in previously elusive Rett syndrome cases through IGV interpretation

variants.variant_type: Translocation (~200 Kbp / 200,391 bp from chromosome 6 to chromosome X); t(6;X)(q26;q28)
variants.clinical_significance: Reported as disease-causing (novel de novo SV)
variants.exon: Breakpoint within MECP2 between exons 3 and 4
variants.protein_effect: Disrupts MECP2 between exons 3 and 4; hypothesized to disrupt normal splicing, potentially triggering NMD or producing an aberrant MECP2 protein; disrupts both isoforms MECP2_e1 and MECP2_e2
variants.null_variant_detail: Predicted to disrupt MECP2 transcript (NM_004992.4, MECP2_e1); possible NMD; considered highly unlikely to produce normal WT protein. Translocated region encompasses complete exons 1 and 2 of PACRG and entire exon 1 of PRKN

variants.variant_type: Complex structural variant (cSV): two deletions (~5 Kbp and ~60 Kbp) and a ~105 Kbp inversion
variants.clinical_significance: Reported as disease-causing (novel de novo SV)
variants.exon: Large deletion removes exons 3 and 4 and the entire 3' UTR
variants.protein_effect: Removes the entire downstream portion of both MECP2 isoforms including exons 3 and 4 and the entire 3' UTR; likely results in transcript undergoing NMD, preventing protein production; disrupts both isoforms MECP2_e1 and MECP2_e2
variants.null_variant_detail: Predicted NMD; partially deleted and inverted TMEM187 and L1CAM at borders

variants.variant_type: Heterozygous deletion (~3,200 bp / ~3 Kbp) in the downstream C-terminal region of MECP2
variants.clinical_significance: Reported as disease-causing (novel de novo SV)
variants.protein_effect: Removes terminal portion of exon 4 resulting in a stop-loss mutation; includes 2,889 bp of the 3' UTR; affects amino acids 397 to 498 and causes a frameshift, generating a novel amino acid sequence of 149 residues before a premature stop codon (stop codon at position 545); disrupts both isoforms MECP2_e1 and MECP2_e2
variants.protein_length_change: Frameshift altering protein sequence starting at amino acid 397; introduces stop codon at position 545; novel sequence of 149 residues
